paragraphs.source_en: That day, rain had been falling since morning. Looking down from the Yagyū Gate, one could see the reddish, muddy torrent of the Ōno River flowing in from the left collide with the clear stream from the right, then surge away like ten thousand galloping horses. The waves roared so fiercely that even the sound of speech was drowned out. Even when the reinforcements arrived, Kyūhachirō mistook them for an enemy attack and hurried up to the turret beside the Yagyū Gate to look.
